Dynamic Period Control

Dynamic period control enables flexible billing where, in a deregulated scenario, actual meter reading results are no longer stored
in a grid defined in scheduling, but can be exchanged between utility companies at any time.

In the billing schema, you can use the time slice generator to create individual correction periods.
You can do the following, for example:

e Recalculate consumption prices from the billing document while leaving the rental price unchanged.

e Define which billing steps are carried out for actual meter reading results and which are carried out for estimated meter
reading results.

e Choose whether a correction is carried out over the entire correction period, or only for individual partial correction
periods.

e Execute advance billing, which the system can recalculate automatically.

You can use a simulation period to generate extrapolated posting-relevant billing line items in dynamic period control, or
information lines in the billing document, and correct them in subsequent billing runs.

This allows you to present any extrapolation periods to your customers on the bill.

Integration

If you have activated the business function Utilities, Quantity Determination (ISU_QD_1) and you use the quantity determination
procedure Quantity Determination During Meter Reading, you cannot use dynamic period control. Dynamic period control cannot
be used in conjunction with the quantity determination procedure Quantity Determination During Meter Reading. Also note that

for registers for which the quantity determination procedure Quantity Determination Procedure During Meter Reading is defined,

you cannot subsequently enter a DPC rate category in the installation.
For more information, see:

Quantity Determination During Meter Reading

Customizing for DPC

You can find the Customizing tables relevant for DPC in Customizing for SAP Utilities under |}*Contract Billing » Billing Master
Data Rate Structure » Schemas } Dynamic Period Control Define Dynamic Period Control %. You can also find a description
of how to create a sample schema, here.

Customizing for Schema Structure

For further information about Customizing settings in the billing schema, see the documentation on the Information for Dynamic
Period Control activity under |}Contract Billing } Billing Master Data» Rate Structure + Schemas } Dynamic Period Control
